name: 2one Solutions
about: 2one Solutions is a design and strategy consultancy helping businesses create structure in an ever-changing technology environment. We build business strategies that better connect you with your customers, leveraging our Design Language System architecture.
tagline: Building business value by improving customer & user experience.
mission: To create structure in an unstructured world.
vision: Help build companies that customers can't stop talking about.

voice.note: How the brand speaks — the enduring character of the language.

tone.note: How that voice adapts to context — reassuring where it matters, decisive where it counts.

color.note: 2one is grayscale-founded. The one brand colour is the accent below — used deliberately for emphasis, never as the whole surface.

accent.name: 2one Blue
accent.role: The single 2one brand accent. Grayscale carries the structure and primary actions; the accent adds emphasis to links, focus, and selection — and to brand moments. It never replaces the near-black/white primary and is never the only signal of state.
accent.accessibility: #30A1FF is the identity hue. Because it is too light to clear the contrast audit as text or as a solid fill, the UI renders APCA-accessible steps of it — a darker blue on light (#1670c9) and a lighter blue on dark (#7cc4ff) — so every pair passes npm run a11y. See tokens/colors.json → ramps.brand and → contrast.

do: Be minimal and contemporary — say it in fewer words.
Be factual and specific; show, don't hype.
Stay empathetic where the reader might be uncertain; be bold where a decision is needed.
On the web, put the outcome first: the H1 and opening line say what the page is and the one thing to do (inverted pyramid).
Write headings that stand alone out of context, in words people search for — no clever or colon ("Topic: subtitle") titles.
Keep one idea per paragraph and use lists for features, files, and steps, so the page is scannable.
Name every link by its destination ("GitHub repository", "live manifest.json") and give the same destination the same label everywhere.
Write for the web in the active voice, second person, with contractions.
dont: Don't add filler, jargon, or generic marketing fluff.
Don't use colour or emphasis as the only way to make a point.
Don't use link text like "click here" or "read more", and don't show a raw URL as the link label.

Don't pad with AI slop — em-dash piles, "not just X, but Y" contrasts, tricolons for their own sake, or bait words (delve, leverage, unlock, elevate, seamless, robust, spearhead, tapestry, landscape, journey, battle-tested) unless the word is a real term from a repo file.
Don't state a capability, price, or metric that isn't backed by a repo file, a command, or a human-provided number.
Don't open with welcome filler ("Welcome to our site") or claim "people don't scroll".

usage_for_ai: Match this voice and tone for any 2one-facing copy. Do not invent brand facts not present here or in brand/BRAND.md.
